name: session-mgmt
description: Manage the full lifecycle of a Claude Code working session. start-session opens a task in a fresh, isolated git worktree (via EnterWorktree, never `git worktree add`) named after the argument, and loads the JIRA story when the name is an issue key. exit-session detects and tears down the ephemeral resources a session created — background processes and dev servers, Docker/compose stacks, local Kubernetes clusters, git worktrees, throwaway local branches, and temp files — with a plan-confirm-execute flow that never destroys data without confirmation.
